conviction_note: Q3 revenue and AEBITDA were pre-released by ad-hoc on 24 Sep and the FY26 guide was cut the same night, so the 5 Nov release mostly confirms known numbers. The two small findings (the FY guide needs roughly flat Q4 AEBITDA year on year, against Deutsche Bank already at the bottom end; supervisory-board-linked buying at about EUR 2.35, now public) almost cancel, sum -0.1. abs_move stays at 5.0 because this is a 63%-vol name with a 7.8% disclosed short, and its results days have moved -8.9, -14.9, -0.6 and -3.0. p_up 47 reflects a name that has sold its last four prints and has already recovered the whole warning drop (2.70 before the ad-hoc, 2.94 now), set against a crowded short that is fuel if the guide is firmed.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue and AEBITDA land inside the pre-released ranges (-11/-12% cc; EUR 45-55m). Where AEBITDA sits in a EUR 10m range is the only open part, and nothing found says which end.

The FY26 EUR 350-370m guide is probably reiterated (it was cut six weeks ago). It implies Q4 AEBITDA of about EUR 150-180m against about EUR 166m in Q4 2025, on revenue down about 10%. A narrowing to the low end is the main downside risk; a firmed or narrowed-up guide on a 7.8% short is the main upside risk.
Q3/9M free cash flow is new: H1 FCF was EUR 49.4m against 156.4m a year earlier. Lean slightly negative, size unknown.
Any commentary on reinvesting in marketing for Q4/2027 or on 2027 shape (revenue decline persisting). Direction unknown; the market will trade on this.
unknown. The buyback programme ended early in March 2026 and nothing new has been announced (no source for a new one).

findings.finding: The cut FY26 guide (AEBITDA EUR 350-370m) needs Q4 2026 AEBITDA of about EUR 150-180m against about EUR 166m in Q4 2025, roughly flat on revenue down about 10%, after 9M of about EUR 190-200m (Q1 23.6 + Q2 121.1 cc + Q3 45-55). The one sourced broker estimate, Deutsche Bank at EUR 350m, already sits at the bottom, and the company has landed at the low end before (Q2 'bottom end' revenue, then the cut).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance lines moved this stock hard: FY26 first guide on 2026-03-18 -14.9%; ad-hoc guide cut 2026-09-24 evening, then -9.8% on 09-25. Q1 2026 with guide reconfirmed: -0.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. If the market feared the low end, the stock would not sit above its pre-warning level (2.70 on 24 Sep, 2.94 on 4 Nov) and the short register would be building rather than covering. Only the arithmetic that Q4 must hold flat year on year is not stated anywhere in the press. Sized small.

findings.finding: After the warning, Active Ownership (closely associated with supervisory board member Florian Schuhbauer) bought on Xetra: EUR 370k at EUR 2.3353 on 30 Sep and EUR 226k at EUR 2.38 on 5 Oct, the last day before the 30-day MAR closed period. findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 9 Oct publication coincided with +8.0% that Friday (Börse Global says no causal link is established). There is no earlier record of this line on results days.
